$description: Console DARK theme, emitted to the .dark block of src/styles/tokens.css by tokens/build.mjs. `palette` holds the values of direction A2 (scripts/check-brand-parity.mjs pins the subset the website shares against the emitted file): four neutrals (frame, canvas, surface, raised), a well and a pane, the hover, selection and pressed layers, three text tones, the single brand orange #f08000 in its roles, the status colours with their soft fills, and the inverse surface of a toast with its text and action. Every text token holds at least 4.5:1 and every control boundary, focus ring and selection border at least 3:1 on every surface, including under the selection and hover fills and on the soft fills (544 pairs over both themes, pinned by src/styles/tokens.test.ts). `tools` holds the four tool data colours, `depth` the neutral shadows, `roles` the names the components use.

frame.$description: Window frame: the sidebar and the gutters around the sheet.

canvas.$description: The sheet: the rounded work area.

surface.$description: Cards, the composer and list groups.

hover.$description: Pointer hover fill: A2's 7% at 0.75, the one factor of the contrast ruling; it stacks on the selected fill.

active.$description: Selection fill: A2's 10% at 0.75, the one factor of the contrast ruling (0.745 is the lowest that keeps the approved concept's selected step on the canvas, 1.26:1).

line.$description: Hairline separator. Decorative only: it never carries information.

ctl-border.$description: Boundary of inputs, selects and switches: at least 3:1 on every surface.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind a modal dialog or sheet.

well.$description: Recessed surface: fields, code, diffs, the terminal, the composer inside a dialog.

pane.$description: A secondary pane beside the page: the session inspector, a folder list, the drawer bar.

pressed.$description: State layer under a pointer that is down.

text-3.$description: Tertiary text, for resting surfaces: on a hovered, selected or soft-filled surface the one tertiary rule of src/index.css gives it the secondary ink (A2).

accent.$description: The brand orange as a FILL: the one primary action, the selected row, running work.

accent-text.$description: The orange as text: A2's #ffa257 made lighter (OKLCH L 0.792 to 0.825, hue kept, chroma lowered only to the sRGB edge) so it holds 4.5:1 on a hovered, selected raised row.

accent-soft.$description: Soft orange fill, opaque: A2's 16% of rgb(240, 128, 0) composited on the surface #343437, so a tag reads the same in a resting, hovered or selected row (a translucent fill stacked on a row's fill took its ink under 4.5:1).

accent-border.$description: Orange boundary and selection bar: at least 3:1 on canvas and surface.

ok-soft.$description: Success soft fill, opaque: A2's 14% of rgb(134, 223, 160) composited on the surface #343437, so a tag reads the same in a resting, hovered or selected row (a translucent fill stacked on a row's fill took its ink under 4.5:1).

warn.$description: Warning text and glyph: gold, never the orange.

warn-soft.$description: Warning soft fill, opaque: A2's 14% of rgb(242, 208, 79) composited on the surface #343437, so a tag reads the same in a resting, hovered or selected row (a translucent fill stacked on a row's fill took its ink under 4.5:1).

bad.$description: Error text and glyph: A2's #ffa1a1 made lighter (OKLCH L 0.803 to 0.828, hue kept, chroma lowered only to the sRGB edge) so it holds 4.5:1 on a hovered, selected raised row.

bad-soft.$description: Error soft fill, opaque: A2's 14% of rgb(255, 161, 161) composited on the surface #343437, so a tag reads the same in a resting, hovered or selected row (a translucent fill stacked on a row's fill took its ink under 4.5:1).

info.$description: Information text and glyph: A2's #99c1f1 made lighter (OKLCH L 0.799 to 0.817, hue and chroma kept) so it holds 4.5:1 on a hovered, selected raised row.

info-soft.$description: Information soft fill, opaque: A2's 14% of rgb(153, 193, 241) composited on the surface #343437, so a tag reads the same in a resting, hovered or selected row (a translucent fill stacked on a row's fill took its ink under 4.5:1).

diff-add.$description: Added line in a diff: 14% of the success colour, translucent.

diff-del.$description: Removed line in a diff: 14% of the error colour, translucent.

inverse.$description: Surface of a toast: the opposite of the theme.

tools.$description: The four tool data colours, in a fixed order that is the tool, never its rank (dataviz validator, 2026-10-17, both themes). Orange is not a series colour: it marks the one thing that needs you. Light aqua is 2.74:1, so every series carries a direct label: identity is never colour alone.

tool-claude.$description: Claude Code, as a data series.

tool-gemini.$description: Gemini CLI, as a data series.

accounts.$description: The nine accent colors an account may carry (orange, green, amber, red, blue, purple, pink, teal, slate; the first five are published, the server's closed list in modules/sessions/provider_account.go). A dot beside the account's label, never the only identity: each holds 3:1 on every surface of its theme, selected and hovered rows included, and the closest pair is 0.094 apart in OKLab (src/styles/tokens.test.ts measures both). Color carries no state, health or authority.

depth.$description: Depth: neutral shadows for cards, wells and what floats. No glow, blur or halo.

shadow-pop.$description: Floating layers: dialogs, sheets and the command palette.

shadow-card.$description: Cards: a hairline ring and a short drop.

shadow-well.$description: The inner edge of a well.

roles.$description: The names the console components paint with today. Each alias is resolved at build time, so the generated file holds the palette value itself and one value lives in one place.

muted.$description: The selection tone as a fill of its own (the value of `active`): neutral badges, hovered menu items and wells.

accent-hover.$description: The primary action on hover: the orange at brightness 1.06, as the design renders it. Ink stays above 4.5:1.

accent-active.$description: The primary action while pressed. Ink stays above 4.5:1.

danger-solid.$description: Solid destructive fill (not part of the palette; kept at its measured value).

danger-solid-foreground.$description: Ink on the solid destructive fill.

confidence-attributed.$description: Access-graph confidence: attributed (a cool axis apart from status).

elevation.$description: The elevation steps the components use: the lower three draw nothing (a card draws `shadow-card`), popovers and dialogs take the upper two.
